steps.label: d = number of times the series is differenced
steps.sub: d=1 is typical for log prices and trending series

steps.label: ARIMA(p,d,q): ARMA(p,q) on the d-th difference
steps.sub: d=0 collapses exactly to plain ARMA

code:
from statsmodels.tsa.arima.model import ARIMA

model = ARIMA(log_prices, order=(1, 1, 1))
fit = model.fit()

forecast = fit.get_forecast(steps=10)
print(forecast.predicted_mean)
print(forecast.conf_int())
caption: order=(p, d, q); d=1 differences once before fitting the ARMA(1,1) part.

code:
from statsmodels.tsa.statespace.sarimax import SARIMAX

model = SARIMAX(
    sales,
    order=(1, 1, 1),
    seasonal_order=(1, 1, 1, 12),
    enforce_stationarity=True,
    enforce_invertibility=True,
)
fit = model.fit(disp=False)
caption: seasonal_order=(P, D, Q, s) adds seasonal AR/I/MA terms at lag multiples of s.
